تستغفروا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْفِرُوا (tastaḡfirū) /tas.taɣ.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# تُسْتَغْفَرُوا (tustaḡfarū) /tus.taɣ.fa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
